title: Do we all visit the same mall?
content: Do you think that everyone who goes to mall world when they sleep visits the same place (despite it looking different to everyone), or do you think mallworld is a phenomenon that happens individually inside each person and that our mall worlds aren't connected? My hypothesis is that mallworld is a manifestation of humanity's collective unconscious (which is why only dream analysis inclined people end up here). We're all tapping into the same thing, but I'm not sure how connected we are there.
